An [[Ebruchi]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] known as "'''Common Cork'''," who was a member of an [[Unidentified Ebruchi clan|Ebruchi clan]], held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[high captain]] and [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] an [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] of the [[Ebruchi (fleet)|Ebruchi fleet]]. The Ebruchi [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ness (pirate)|Ness]] was Cork's subordinate; Cork, in turn, served under the command of the [[Unidentified Ebruchi chieftain|chieftain]] of the Ebruchi [[Flux Screw fleet]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Common Cork" was introduced in the [[2010]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
